# `inclusive-index-bound`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: quick fix · Options: none

Reports an inclusive `index <= len`-style assertion used before indexing that
requires `index < len`.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Equality still permits an out-of-bounds access, so the assertion does not
establish the safety condition it appears to prove.

## When it fires

It applies when the asserted index and the following indexed sequence can be
matched directly.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const std = @import("std");

fn at(items: []const u8, index: usize) u8 {
    std.debug.assert(index <= items.len);
    return items[index];
}
```
